answer: The delta cap is enforced at intake and wander makes public the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, since each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a river tag. That is 30 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
